title: Finiteness properties of closed subgroups of Thompson's group $F$
summary: A subgroup $H$ of Thompson's group $F$ is closed if every piecewise-$H$ function in $F$ belongs to $H$. Prominent examples of closed subgroups are the maximal subgroups of infinite index, stabilizers and pointwise stabilizers of sets of points, and many of Jones' subgroups. A closed subgroup is finitely generated if and only if its Stallings $2$-core is finite, and it is then isomorphic to a diagram group over the core, in the sense of Guba and Sapir.
